newsitem.title: THAILAND: Thai May wholesale prices up 0.1 pct yr/yr.
newsitem.headline: Thai May wholesale prices up 0.1 pct yr/yr.

text.p: The Thai wholesale price index (WPI) rose 0.1 percent year-on-year in May against a 0.9 percent increase in the previous month, the Commerce Ministry said on Monday.
The ministry said wholesale prices rose 0.3 percent in May from April against a 0.4 percent month-on-month rise in the previous month.
The ministry said the 1985-based index rose to 156.3 in May from its 156.1 level in May 1996.
